entries.justification: Route /cbom, theme light, rule color-contrast. This entry was REVEALED, not created, by Phase 216's light-theme sweep (216-01/216-04, D-01/D-02): the a11y harness swept dark only before this phase, so no light-theme baseline for this route ever existed. The underlying colour debt pre-dates this phase; only the harness's ability to see it is new. The sole sample (`bg-[hsl(var(--status-warning))] text-black` "At Risk") pairs a `bg-[hsl(var(--status-warning))]` or `bg-[hsl(var(--chart-tls))]` badge background with a literal `text-black` foreground class — one of the 29 `text-black` sites FIX-02 (Phase 217) classifies and FIX-03 (Phase 217) repairs with a theme-varying `-foreground` token (analysis already shows no static colour passes AA in both themes for either token; REQUIREMENTS.md FIX-02). Per 216-CONTEXT.md D-04/D-09, this phase BASELINES this finding rather than fixing it: a phase whose job is instrument repair (fixing the harness's fixture and theme coverage) must not also change product pixels, or a red gate becomes unattributable to either change on its own.
